title: EHRSQL: A Practical Text-to-SQL Benchmark for Electronic Health Records
reasoning: The paper discusses 'trustworthy QA systems' in the context of ensuring accuracy and the ability to distinguish answerable from unanswerable questions to prevent 'fatal mistakes' in clinical decisions. This operational definition of trustworthiness focuses on system reliability and safety, rather than a broader evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics. The paper does not delve into ethical considerations beyond system correctness and refusing to answer when uncertain.
